summary: SEND (module=express) homepage CMS migration tested end-to-end: backend public/admin API, insert-only seeding across backend restart, website /send (390 mobile + 1440 desktop, FR/EN), tile routing, Admin Homepage Management SENDbakēd module + editors + preview link, native Expo SEND home (order, testIDs, routing, offline cache, tablet 820/1024, EN), live sync (title change, tile disable, movers first, trust text, map disabled, tiles above pickup) on website mobile+desktop and native, then exact restore (DIFF []). Regression: native SHOP/MART/FOOD CMS homes render, website /, /shop, /food render. All requested features PASS; only minor UX issues found.

minor.issue: test_mart_homepage_cms.py::test_ten_sections_in_order + test_trust_strip_bilingual fail when run together with test_homepage_cms.py under pytest-xdist (pytest.ini forces -n); test_homepage_cms mutates MART CI rows concurrently. Pass 9/9 when run alone. Test isolation issue, not app bug.

issues: Grid keeps md:grid-cols-[45%_1fr]; right 55% becomes empty black space. Left panel should go full width (or 1-col grid) when mapSection is absent.
Field label says 'Tiles (order = display)' but the list editor has no move up/down controls – admin can only reorder tiles by Remove + re-Add. Add reorder buttons for list items.
List item sub-fields reuse identical data-testids (hp-field-key, hp-field-title_fr ... repeated 6x) and Remove button has no data-testid.

Stale 'module-next-phase-note' ('Le parcours complet de commande arrive très bientôt dans l’app…') still renders under the trust banner although SEND booking (/send/book, /send/movers) is live in the app – contradicts the CMS home; consider hiding it for express.
390px: 'Déménagement & Transport' breaks mid-word ('Déménagem ent & …') on native and is clipped ('Déménageme') on website mobile/desktop tiles.

While /api/homepage loads (sections=null) or on error (sections=[]) the mobile page renders only the top bar and desktop only the header – no skeleton and no fallback to the built-in 6 tiles (native has an offline cache, website does not).
ExpressHomeMobile/ExpressDesktopHome still fetch /express/vehicles and define start/shortcutCards which are now unused (dead code + wasted request).

action_items: Desktop /send: collapse to single-column left panel when send_map_hero is disabled
Admin list editor: add up/down reorder for tiles (label promises order = display)
Hide module-next-phase-note on native express home
Optional: website /send loading skeleton + fallback when /api/homepage fails; remove unused vehicles fetch in ExpressHome.jsx
critical_code_review_comments: ExpressHome.jsx: vehicles fetch/start/shortcutCards unused after CMS migration.
SendServiceTiles.jsx: title always FR (title_fr || title_en) even in EN mode – matches 'FR primary / EN secondary' design, intended.
Native multi tile routes to /send/book?service=multiple_shipments while website uses dedicated /send/multi-shipments wizard – matches spec, but UX differs between platforms.
Native routes /send/book and /send/movers redirect unauthenticated users to /login?redirect=... correctly.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 SEND tests; 40/42 combined, 2 pre-existing flaky MART tests due to parallel mutation)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Temporary TEST_x rows created/deleted by tests; CI express rows mutated and restored exactly (restore DIFF [] extra []).
